name: Coalossal

attacks.name: Mountain Crush
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. For each heads, discard the top card of your opponent’s deck.

flavor:
To intimidate its opponents, Coalossal will
vigorously shake its body, scattering coal from
its smoldering back.

pokedex.text: NO. 0839 Coal Pokémon HT: 9'2" WT: 684.5 lbs.
